item.title: Truckies lose use of Newell Hwy rest area until mid-April
item.description: This stop on the Newell will be closed until mid-April. Image: Google Maps Essential road work now underway on the Newell Highway at Grong Grong, NSW, means truckies will be prevented from pulling into the Henwood Rest Area for next few months.
